landingPage.heroDescription: A single-page site for a weekend baker with a countdown to the order cut-off, collection slots that fill up, and orders reserved by email.
landingPage.about: Bakery Preorder is a single-page website for a home or weekend microbakery that bakes small batches to order. It answers the two questions that decide every preorder: how long is left to order, and which collection slots still have space. An oven-timer countdown runs to your weekly cut-off and rolls to next week once it passes. Collection slots show how much room is left and close when they are full. Customers choose bakes and quantities, see a running total, and send the order to you by email, so there is no payment system to set up. Your menu, prices, slots and cut-off live in one data file. It is built with Astro and TypeScript and deploys from GitHub to Hostinger.

features.title: Order cut-off countdown
features.description: An oven-timer countdown runs to your weekly cut-off and rolls to next week once it passes.

features.title: Collection slots that fill
features.description: Slot tags show the space left, flag nearly full slots and close fully booked ones.

features.title: Weekend menu
features.description: List your bakes with photos, prices and units, ready to change every week.

features.title: Live order ticket
features.description: Customers pick quantities and a slot and see their items, total and collection date update.

features.title: Email reservations
features.description: Orders open as a prefilled email to you, with a copy-text fallback, so no payment setup is needed.

features.title: Edit in one file
features.description: Menu, prices, slots and cut-off time live in one data file you can update in minutes.
